evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth, 3.02 → 3.51 Torr (k=20→26), well above the stable ~3.00 Torr held through ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not due to increased inlet flow
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control appears fine
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so atmosphere integrity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: close or step Ar and watch pressure response) to distinguish a downstream exhaust blockage from an air in-leak through a seal.
